test_title: PYST 64: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill the blank in the given situation.

I thought Sadhna would always stick by me, but when I got into trouble, she turned out to be a/an __________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **fair-weather friend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fair-weather friend"** refers to someone who is only a friend when circumstances are pleasant or profitable and abandons others in times of trouble. (सुविधा का मित्र)

 
 
• **Example: **When I lost my job, I realized he was just a fair-weather friend because he stopped calling me.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. fair-weather friend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hard nut to crack** (सख्त समस्या या व्यक्ति): A problem that is difficult to solve or a person who is difficult to deal with.

 
 
• **Example: **The detective found the case to be a hard nut to crack due to the lack of evidence.
 
 
 
• **Open secret** (खुला राज): Something that is supposed to be confidential but is widely known.
 
 
• **Example: **It is an open secret that the celebrity couple is planning to get married.
 
 
 
• **White elephant** (महंगा और अनुपयोगी संपत्ति): An expensive item that is troublesome to maintain and often more costly than it is worth.
 
 
• **Example: **That luxury car quickly became a white elephant due to its high maintenance costs.
